(3) [F14Where this Part applies by virtue of section 1(2)(c), this section does not apply
unless—
(a) a copy of the notice of transfer, and
(b) copies of the documents containing the evidence,
have been given to the accused under regulations made under paragraph 4 of
Schedule 6 to the M7Criminal Justice Act 1991.]
[F15(3A) Where this Part applies by virtue of section 1(2)(cc), this section does not apply
unless—
(a) copies of the documents containing the evidence have been served on the
accused under regulations made under paragraph 1 of Schedule 3 to the Crime
and Disorder Act 1998; and
(b) a copy of the notice under [F16subsection (1) of section 51D ] of that Act has
been served on him under that subsection.]
